reviews.review: Mass Effect 3 (2012) the end of the Mass Effect Trilogy story from 07' to 2012' - I just finished the third game today with a friend (watching) that had previously played it and oh boy! WHAT AN ADVENTURE WE HAD! The game has a solid... solid continuation from the second Mass Effect! They all flow so well together... the story telling was perfect for me. This entry eats protein all day and then decides to do weights for like 20 hours because all the action ect... get's puuuumped up to 11... which it should for a final installment. Characters are all pretty much amazing, most are interesting and worthwhile listening to... maybe except one but I won't say who! (You know who you are). This one has the best combat out of the trilogy... gunplay and stuff just feels nice as hell, the powers you possess are awesome to use and feel impactful as well, couldn't recommend it enough. Choice I felt like came big into play with this one... you see decisions from the first and second game come into play in this one which just makes it all feel so connected and good! So yeah, Mass Effect 3! A felt like was a great way to end off the trilogy for me! I was quite happy with my ending :). Game gets a solid 9/10 as well. Is it my favourite in the series? I dunno, I feel like it's tied between 2 or 3... might have to do another play through to fully decide but what you need to go and do is buy this! START WITH MASS EFFECT 1 AND SMASH THE TRILOGY OUT! play em all!! I did over the past couple of weeks and woowee what a fun time I've had! GET IT NOW!

Intelligent storyline, fun to play, and had numerous variables that had me replaying a few scenes to see different outcomes.
Downsides: 
When the game is over it’s over. It would be nice to restart the game with my current inventory.
Not great with a controller. I missed the first few interactive parts to right/left click during conversation expecting my triggers to work.

Right, Right, Good game and all, But, I can't for the life of me locate my wife, She'd better not be back at Omega again. 
- The stressed commander of an alternate universe N7 Normandy, Commander Potato Shepard.
I have played the game since I was little and I still now really like the story and like all the cool stuf you can do in it.

34.5 Hours.  
Visualise that. This is the first time I've played this game after 10 years of having enjoyed Mass Effect 2.

34.5 Hours. Immersive enough? 
I'm in awe. 

I only have gratitude left after such experience. 

Just... wow...
